title: Text: Uncle Paul ↔ Anthony Fenech
snippet: Hi Anthony. We are going to miss you but if your plans change, stop by anytime on Sunday. There will be plenty to eat. Happy Easter. Hope you are dressed warm for today. Baseball in March. Crazy
